row.title: UNATTENDED-365: one year with zero external input is the target, measured by a register of every remaining input
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-20. doctrine/unattended.json lists each credential, renewal, quota, hosted model, dependency, outside session and identity act as closed (self-renewing, with probe), gate (identity-bound, default and one link) or open (queue item Q-YEAR-*). Horizon measured 2026-11-20: 161 days. NEEDS-YOU.md hides an act whose dependency measured closed.
